## Triage: addendum from the #34150 misgrade · 2026-11-15T23:45Z

⛔ Not a claim.

Add one precondition to change 1: before grading a queue-flake anchor p0, confirm that the failing case exists on `main`. The merge-queue-triage workflow counts groups stacked behind one queued pull as independent heads. So a pull's own new failing test (#34150, from PR #34097) can look like three independent hits when it is one pull. In that case the remedy is to dequeue that pull, not a p0 or a jump. ui#1's reading on #34150 (22:53Z) is the worked example.
